in_marathi.name: Balgopal
in_marathi.long_meaning: Balgopal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Balgopal is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'ball' and 'gopal'. 'Ball' refers to a protector, while 'gopal' is a cowherd. Balgopal is a name given to the infant Krishna, who is known as the protector of the cows and their calves.
